title: Device onboarding checklist and stability gates for heterogeneous GPU fleet
creator: Marina Velasquez
description: Purpose: Create a repeatable, device-specific onboarding checklist and a small set of enforceable stability gates for publishing hardware performance profiles across A100/H100/L40S/MI300 variants. This ticket consolidates the steps, required artifacts, test signals, and post-publish monitoring expectations so that model owners and runtime engineers can onboard a new model variant with minimal iteration and clear rollback criteria. Scope: onboarding checklist + perf profile field spec + stability gate thresholds + canonical test plan + templates for release notes and dashboard links. Out of scope: kernel-level optimization work (tracked separately) and billing integration details.
acceptance_criteria: A1: A documented onboarding checklist exists and is published to Confluence with step-by-step tasks for each device family (A100/H100/L40S/MI300)

A2: Performance profile JSON schema is finalized and contains required fields: throughput, latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99), memory footprint, optimal batch sizes, sequence-length buckets, quantization variant, and stability signature hash

A3: Stability gates defined such that a profile may be published iff p95 latency is within 20% of the validated baseline for the model-family and throughput delta <= 25% for the target use-case, and memory headroom >= 8GB on target instance
A4: A canonical test run (synthetic + representative prompt set) completes in CI for each device family and artifacts (logs, flamegraphs, trace samples) are attached to the onboarding Confluence page
A5: Dashboard links and alert rules (regression alert + OOM alert + spike in error rate) are created and documented in the release notes template
onboarding_steps: Step 1: Create model entry in model-catalog and set model-family + expected seq_len buckets
Step 2: Build model artifacts with the runtime-compatible packaging (quantized and fp16 variants where applicable)
Step 3: Run per-device calibration job (warmup + KV-cache validation + steady-state sampling) and save raw traces
Step 4: Run multi-batch sweep to discover optimal batch sizes per seq_len bucket (record throughput and latency percentiles)
Step 5: Capture memory/resident set size at peak and idle, verify memory headroom >= 8GB on target SKU
Step 6: Compute stability signature (test harness seed + input corpus + kernel-variant tag) and store with artifacts
Step 7: Submit PR to model-catalog with perf profile JSON, release notes, and links to CI artifacts
Step 8: Canary publish to 5% traffic on target SKU, monitor for 72 hours before full publish
stability_gates: Gate 1 (Latency): p95_latency <= baseline_p95 * 1.20 for target seq_len and batch
Gate 2 (Throughput): throughput >= baseline_throughput * 0.75 for representative workload
Gate 3 (Memory): memory_headroom >= 8GB (safety buffer) on published SKU
Gate 4 (Flakiness): <5% failed requests in synthetic run (timeouts, OOMs, kernel faults)
Gate 5 (Determinism): stability_signature must match recorded signature for model-version+kernel-variant unless documented change is present
test_plan: Synthetic load profile: constant rps sweep across batch sizes and seq_len buckets (CI job)
Representative prompt suite: 2000 prompts reflective of customer traffic (produce p95/p99)
Cold start test: container spin-up and first-token latency measured 50x
KV cache validation: warmup/kvcache correctness tests and JIT cache hit-rate measurement
Canary rollout: 5% traffic for 72 hours with rollback policy if any gate trips
Chaos scenario: simulated GPU preemption/OOM and verify graceful fallback to smaller model variant
